"''They reap what they sow. When the people show loyalty to the Empire, they will be allowed to flourish. But not before.|Barriss Offee and the Fourth Sister|}} A '''rocky planet''' that had two moons and orbited a red sun was home to a [[Unidentified settlement (rocky planet)|settlement]]. After the [[Great Jedi Purge|fall]] of the [[Jedi Order]] and rise of the [[Galactic Empire]], a [[Unidentified human Jedi|Jedi]] who survived the Order's destruction went into hiding on the [[planet]], working alongside a local [[Unidentified rebel cell|rebel cell]]. The Empire's [[Inquisitorius]] [[Mission to a rocky planet|dispatched]] two [[Inquisitor]]s, the [[Fourth Sister]] and [[Barriss Offee]], to hunt down the [[Jedi]]. As a result of the local populace sympathising with the rebel cell, the settlement and surrounding area was severely damaged, impoverished, and neglected by the Empire. After the Inquisitors arrived at the settlement, its [[Unidentified human governor|governor]] claimed there were no Jedi on the planet, although Offee learned from a [[Unidentified human girl (rocky planet)|girl]] that the Jedi was hiding in the [[mountain]]s. In retaliation, the Fourth Sister [[Death|slaughtered]] the gathered citizens, and the two Inquisitors went to find the Jedi. During the ensuing [[Lightsaber duel|duel]], Offee eventually convinced the Jedi to surrender, but the Fourth Sister struck them down regardless. Offee, discovering the Jedi was still alive, turned against the Fourth Sister when she refused to help them, throwing her fellow Inquisitor off the cliff before renouncing her allegiance to the Empire and returning to save the Jedi. {{Planet-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{TOTE|Realization}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Planeta rocoso no identificado (Inquisidores) |ka=უცნობი კლდოვანი პლანეტა (ინკვიზიტორები) }} [[Category:Rocky planets]]
